tools.description: Publish a version - Transitions a draft version to published status. Only one version per form can be published at a time.

tools.description: Create a submission - Accepts a form submission for asynchronous processing. An Idempotency-Key header is required to prevent duplicate submissions.

tools.description: Normalize a submission - Validates and normalizes a form submission synchronously, returning a canonical fact map. No data is persisted.
tools.name: forms-api__post_api_v1_submissions_normalize

tools.description: Replay a submission - Re-publishes the submission event for reprocessing by downstream consumers.
tools.name: forms-api__post_api_v1_submissions_submissionId_replay

tools.description: Create a tag - Creates a new tag for the tenant. The key must be unique within the tenant and is used as the stable identifier for tag-to-field associations.
tools.name: forms-api__post_api_v1_tags

tools.description: Create a tag version - Creates a new draft version for the tag. Versions follow a draft → active → deprecated → retired lifecycle and define the data type associated with the tag.
tools.name: forms-api__post_api_v1_tags_tagId_versions

tools.description: Publish a tag version - Transitions a draft tag version to active status, making it the live version for the tag. If another version is currently active, it is automatically transitioned to deprecated within the same transaction. Only one version per tag can be active at a time.
tools.name: forms-api__post_api_v1_tags_tagId_versions_versionId_publish
